```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(data.table)

breaks <- 10^(-10:10)
minor_breaks <- rep(5, 21)*(10^rep(-10:10, each=9))


high_roh_bcftools <- read.table('HIGH_cod_filtered_variants_ROH.txt', header=TRUE)
high_roh_bcftools$cat <- "HIGH"
high_roh_bcftools_min10kb <-high_roh_bcftools[high_roh_bcftools$Length>=10000,]

low_roh_bcftools <- read.table('LOW_cod_filtered_variants_ROH.txt', header=TRUE)
low_roh_bcftools$cat <- "LOW"
low_roh_bcftools_min10kb <-low_roh_bcftools[low_roh_bcftools$Length>=10000,]


ROH_df <- rbind(high_roh_bcftools, low_roh_bcftools)

ROH_df_min10kb <- ROH_df[ROH_df$Length>=10000,]

ROH_len_variants <-ggplot(high_roh_bcftools_min10kb, aes(x = Length, group=Sample)) +
  geom_step(stat="bin", bins=20, direction="mid", aes(colour="HIGH"), linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_step(data=low_roh_bcftools_min10kb, aes(x=Length, colour="LOW"), stat="bin", bins=20, direction="mid", linewidth = 1) + 
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans='log10', label=comma, breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14)) +
  scale_colour_manual(name="Variants", values = c("HIGH"= "#f1a340","LOW"="#998ec3")) +
  xlab("Length of ROH") +
  ylab("Number of ROHs") +
  annotation_logticks(sides="b")

ROH_len_variants
```

```{r}
high_all_roh_bcftools <- read.table('HIGH_cod_filtered_allsites_ROH.txt', header=TRUE)

ROH_len_all <-ggplot(high_all_roh_bcftools_min10kb, aes(x = Length, group=Sample)) +

ROH_len_all
```

```{r}
high_ind_roh_bcftools <- read.table('high_variants_cod_ROH_ind', header=FALSE)
low_ind_roh_bcftools <- read.table('low_variants_cod_ROH_ind', header=FALSE)
high_all_ind_roh_bcftools <- read.table('high_allsites_cod_ROH_ind', header=FALSE)
low_all_ind_roh_bcftools <- read.table('low_allsites_cod_ROH_ind', header=FALSE)

high_ind_roh_bcftools$cat <- "HIGH"
low_ind_roh_bcftools$cat <- "LOW"
high_all_ind_roh_bcftools$cat <- "HIGH"
low_all_ind_roh_bcftools$cat <- "LOW"
high_ind_roh_bcftools$data <- "variants"
low_ind_roh_bcftools$data <- "variants"
high_all_ind_roh_bcftools$data <- "allsites"
low_all_ind_roh_bcftools$data <- "allsites"

ind_ROH_df <- rbind(high_ind_roh_bcftools, low_ind_roh_bcftools, high_all_ind_roh_bcftools, low_all_ind_roh_bcftools)
colnames(ind_ROH_df) <- c("Sample", "FROH_1kb", "Num", "Length", "Filters", "Data")
ind_ROH_df <- ind_ROH_df %>%
                  mutate(Group = paste(Filters, Data, sep = "_"))

ggplot(ind_ROH_df) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = Group, y = FROH_1kb, fill = Filters)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Filters", values = c("HIGH"= "#f1a340","LOW"="#998ec3")) +
  xlab("Filtering regime")
```


```{r}
library(detectRUNS)
  
slidingRuns_high_all <- slidingRUNS.run(
  genotypeFile = "./cod_filtered_allsites_high.ped", 
  mapFile = "./cod_filtered_allsites_high.map", 
  windowSize = 15, 
  threshold = 0.05,
  minSNP = 20, 
  ROHet = FALSE, 
  maxOppWindow = 1, 
  maxMissWindow = 1,
  maxGap = 10^6, 
  minLengthBps = 100000, 
  minDensity = 1/10^3, # SNP/kbps
  maxOppRun = NULL,
  maxMissRun = NULL
) 

high_all_roh_ind <- slidingRuns_high_all %>% group_by(group) %>% summarise(total_length=sum(lengthBps))%>% mutate(FROH=(total_length/653355439))

#####
```

```{r}

low_variants_roh_ind$cat <- "LOW"
high_variants_roh_ind$cat <- "HIGH"
low_all_roh_ind$cat <- "LOW"
high_all_roh_ind$cat <- "HIGH"
low_variants_roh_ind$data <- "var"
high_variants_roh_ind$data <- "var"
low_all_roh_ind$data <- "all"
high_all_roh_ind$data <- "all"


detectRuns_ROH_df <- rbind(high_all_roh_ind, low_all_roh_ind, high_variants_roh_ind, low_variants_roh_ind)
colnames(detectRuns_ROH_df) <- c("Sample", "Total_Length", "FROH_1kb", "Filters", "Data")
detectRuns_ROH_df <- detectRuns_ROH_df %>%
                  mutate(Group = paste(Filters, Data, sep = "_"))

ggplot(detectRuns_ROH_df) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = Group, y = FROH_1kb, fill = Filters)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name="Filters", values = c("HIGH"= "#f1a340","LOW"="#998ec3")) +
  xlab("Filtering regime")
```
